in_hebrew.name: ארלו
in_hebrew.meaning: ארלו הוא שם שמשמעותו לא ידועה במקור העברי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ארלו הוא שם שמקורו אינו ברור בשפה העברית. אין לו משמעות ברורה או התייחסות ישירה בכתבי הקודש העבריים. ייתכן כי השם ארלו הוא גרסה שונה או שינוי של שם עברי אחר.

in_greek.name: Άρλο

in_english.name: Arlo
in_english.meaning: The name Arlo signifies strength and courage in battle
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arlo, while not directly mentioned in the Bible, is believed to have roots in Old English or possibly a derivative of the Germanic word for 'noble' or 'strong'. Historically, it may relate to names signifying strength and courage, traits valued in Christian tradition. The name Arlo has seen a resurgence in modern times as a given name, symbolizing a blend of nobility and vigor.

biblical_reference.note: The name Arlo does not have a direct reference in the Bible.

data.cultural_impact: Arlo has gained popularity in contemporary culture, particularly through American singer-songwriter Arlo Guthrie, known for his protest songs and his socially and environmentally conscious lyrics. The name has also been featured in various media, including books and films, as well as being a common character name in American fiction.
data.spiritual_significance: Arlo is a name of strength and resilience, echoing the fortified hill or strong place of refuge suggested by its Old English roots. It reflects the biblical theme of God as a stronghold and refuge in times of challenge, as expressed in Psalm 46:1: "God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble." The name encourages those who bear it to be strong in their faith, trusting in the Lord's protection and guidance in all circumstances.

historical_references.reference: Arlo was a medieval given name, possibly derived from the Old English words 'arl' meaning 'noble' and 'wulf' meaning 'wolf'.
historical_references.context: In medieval England, Arlo was a relatively common name among the nobility.
